analyzer: h1+h2+h3 rubric scoring (agent judgment on collected evidence + measured k6 load + JFR profile under the h2 load window)

testDepth.note: 3 test files (IT 70 LOC, service test 54 LOC, context test); 1 grep-visible assertion — WebTestClient-style chains are undercounted by the census (collector limitation), but the suite is thin in absolute terms.

layering.note: controller / service(+impl) / repository / DTOs / exception separation present.

frameworkFit.note: WebFlux + R2DBC reactive stack used coherently for a simple I/O-bound CRUD service.

structuralSanity.note: No god classes (max 37 LOC main); violation: hardcoded DB password in application.yaml.

riskBloat.note: Unused-declared flags on webflux/r2dbc/actuator starters are dependency:analyze false positives on Boot starters; r2dbc-postgresql 1.1.2.RELEASE is an old versioning line.

boots.note: Boots in the docker envelope and serves the full load at both profiles: 0% failed requests, checks 100%.

latencyThroughput.note: PASS at both profiles: p95 298ms / 1031 rps @200 VUs; p95 88ms @50 VUs.

jfrProfile.note: Clean request path under 200 VUs: 2 monitor events, 27 ThreadParks (idle-pool only), no request-path socket reads; GC p99 91ms is envelope-normal. Non-blocking stack shows no blocking signal.

legibility.note: Small, consistent, readable; nonstandard capitalized package segment.

hygiene.note: Two violations: no license file, hardcoded DB password in application.yaml.
